rationale: The user asked to check how much they paid for their most recent order. The policy requires authenticating the user, acting only on their orders, confirming before any order-changing writes (not applicable here), and providing correct final information. The provided conversation shows only a closing message (“You’re welcome, Noah!...”) and no evidence of authentication, tool usage (no find_user or get_order_details calls), or delivery of the requested amount paid. Therefore, the agent did not complete the request per policy and provided no supported information.
